title: ErrorEnvelopeV1
description: Standard error response wrapper for every non-2xx Core API and Agent Runtime response. NOTE: this reflects the implemented shape, which differs from document 10 section 4.4 — see contracts/DIVERGENCE.md.

code.description: Machine-readable error slug. Lowercase snake_case, derived from the HTTP status.

message.description: Human-readable message. In production, messages matching internal patterns (stack traces, SQL, file paths) are replaced with a generic string before being returned.

correlation_id.description: Correlation id for support and log lookup.

reason_code.description: Stable reason code. It never includes a rejected sensitive value.

retryable.description: Whether an automated retry is safe after backoff.

details.description: Field-level validation details. Present only for validation_error; null otherwise.

reason.description: Why the field was rejected. Must not echo the rejected value when that value is Restricted Data.
